findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_receipt, points_leaderboard, sign_in, open_link_instructions · Private data: open_link, payment_compat_check, create_link, get_started, buy_membership, redeem_premium_code, set_points_prefs, sign_in, whoami, sessions, agent_keys, my_preferences · Public sink: open_link · Destructive: open_link, payment_compat_check, set_link_status, my_preferences.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_receipt, points_leaderboard, sign_in, open_link_instructions · Private data: open_link, payment_compat_check, create_link, get_started, buy_membership, redeem_premium_code, set_points_prefs, sign_in, whoami, sessions, agent_keys, my_preferences · Public sink: open_link · Destructive: open_link, payment_compat_check, set_link_status, my_preferences

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
